content: Security First (OWASP Top 10): NEVER hardcode secrets (API keys, DB URLs). Use .env. ALWAYS validate inputs with Zod or Pydantic. SQL Injection: Use ORMs or parameterized queries. Never string-concat SQL. Auth: Use httpOnly, secure, sameSite=strict cookies. Rate Limiting: Max 5 login attempts per 15 mins. CORS: Restrict to specific origins. Never use wildcard (*) in production. Dependencies: Run npm audit or pip-audit regularly.
